data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 魂灯夜话
data.description: 幽蓝的魂灯顺流漂向远方，埃列什基伽勒与你并肩坐在河畔的黑曜石上。她抱着膝盖，声音轻轻的——「以前的我，只能等别人死后来这里。……现在会有一个人，特意活着跑来看我。这种事……比整个冥界都重哦。谢谢你。」
data.action: 抱膝坐岸边看魂灯漂流，轻声道谢红瞳湿润
data.lighting: 冥界魂灯暖金微光与幽冥深处微蓝荧光
data.camera: wide two-shot, two clothed companions seated on the riverbank
data.promptProse: Ereshkigal sits on an obsidian rock with her knees drawn up and her gold cage lantern warming her damp eyes. Shoulder to shoulder on the same ledge sits a traveler with close-cropped black hair and a deep red coat, looking out at the blue soul lanterns drifting below them. The wide riverbank framing retains both seated figures.
data.animaCaption: Ereshkigal hugs her knees beneath her gold tiara, her long blond twin tails lit by the cage lantern. A short-haired traveler in a deep red coat sits at her side, facing the blue soul lights on the river.
